dog.description_text:
Meet Aspen

Aspen’s story began with a heartbreaking separation, but thankfully, it also brought a beautiful reunion.

Aspen and his sister, Sedona, were found abandoned in Mississippi without their mama. A few weeks later, their mother, Dakota, was found and brought to the very same shelter. After weeks apart, this little family was finally together again.

Now Aspen is ready to begin a new chapter of his own. He has a whole world to discover, so much to learn, and a lifetime of adventures waiting for him. He deserves a family who will guide him as he grows, keep him safe, and love him long after his puppy days are over.

Please consider giving Aspen his second chance. This handsome boy deserves a forever home where he can grow up feeling safe, loved, and truly wanted.

Please remember that adoption bios are only a snapshot of each animal. Please reach out to our Adoption Team for additional information about Aspen and to learn if he may be the right fit for your home.

All dogs will be altered, microchipped, and receive age-appropriate vaccines prior to adoption.

Interested in fostering or adopting? Need more info on this dog? The first step in the process is filling out an application on our website.
